name: fix_missing_lib_files_in_reused_pro_into_9e72ab71
subject: 🤖 Pick PR #63239 (Fix missing lib files in reused pro...) into release-6.0 (#63246)
not_strict_reasons: no failing case added by the fix

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Reused program structure drops default lib files from libFiles when files are rebuilt, so the lib files go missing; the fix adds newly created default-lib source files to libFiles. This is a watch/incremental program-reuse correctness bug.
